description: Create a new CyberBrick project from a built-in template (the app's createProjectFromTemplate flow: template config + addFirmware). Templates: forklift, truck, forklift_and_truck, ball_car, official_remote, none, custom. MUTATING (adds a project to the app's list).

name.description: Project name (max 31 chars, as the app validates). Defaults to the template's own name.

name: project_create
title: Create project from template
